description: This file contains hook implementations for the Drupal Help module, providing help text, section alterations, and help topic modifications.

methods.name: hook_help
methods.description: Provides help content for specific routes or pages within the Drupal help system.

methods.name: hook_help_section_info_alter
methods.description: Allows alteration of help page section plugin definitions, such as titles and order.

methods.name: hook_help_topics_info_alter
methods.description: Allows alteration of help topic plugin definitions, such as setting top-level display.
